caption_used: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline MistralV0.2-Base and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The chart displays six specialty groups along the x-axis (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), with the y-axis showing negative log probability ranging from approximately -27 to -22. Within each group, the MistralV0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently shows the highest negative log probability, indicating weaker token predictions at baseline. Among the fine-tuned models, the Gastro-tuned variant achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups, suggesting strong cross-specialty transfer. Notably, the Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with baseline reaching approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between baseline and fine-tuned variants at roughly 1.5 units.
raw_response: The chart is a grouped bar chart illustrating the negative log probability of clinically relevant tokens for the MistralV0.2-Base model and its fine-tuned variants across six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms,” lists these specialties in order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from approximately -27 to -22. Within each specialty group, there are multiple bars: a single light blue bar representing the MistralV0.2-Base model, and a set of colored bars (light orange for Cardio, peach for Gastro, orange for Infect, dark orange for Neuro, brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics) representing the model fine-tuned on that specific specialty. The light blue baseline bar is consistently the tallest (most negative) in each group, indicating the weakest token prediction probability at baseline. The fine-tuned bars are generally shorter (less negative) than the baseline, indicating improved token prediction for terms within their respective specialty. The Gastro-tuned model consistently achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups. The Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with the baseline bar reaching approximately -23.5. The Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between the baseline and fine-tuned bars, at roughly 1.5 units. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the specialty labels. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar beyond the color coding and legend.
